boltons/excutils.py `_DeferredLine.__str__` returns None (not a string) when linecache cannot find the source line (e.g. frames from pytest's assertion-rewritten or otherwise unavailable sources), so `_DeferredLine.strip()`/`__len__` and thus `traceback.format_list(full_trace)` raise TypeError. This makes `str()`/`get_str()` of an ExceptionCauseMixin wrapped inside a handler fail in such environments. It should return '' instead of None. tests/test_excutils.py::test_wrap_inside_handler_keeps_traceback is marked xfail(strict) pending this.
